name: What are some popular design trends for bathroom remodels right now?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular design trends for bathroom remodels right now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current bathroom design trends often focus on creating a spa-like retreat. This includes elements like natural materials such as wood and stone, freestanding tubs, large walk-in showers with frameless glass, and smart technology integrations like heated floors and smart mirrors. Neutral color palettes with pops of color, ample storage, and good lighting are also popular choices for modern bathroom remodels.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular bathroom remodel trends include spa-like designs with natural materials, walk-in showers, smart technology, and neutral color palettes.
